events.name: Yule
events.text: Six candles burn the weeks down to the longest night. The first stream of each week lights the next and wakes its rune.

events.name: Moon Night
events.text: Omens run wild, Beings stir sooner and the Madness flows a little thicker while the moon is full.

events.name: Lucia
events.text: Lucia brings the light: every soul who signs the ledger gets a Ritual Candle, and the circles close sooner.

events.name: The Festival
events.text: Lanterns wind up the hill at Kingsport. Beings crowd the dark and the Thorn things walk the Delve.

events.name: The Ledger Turns
events.text: The ledger turns a page. One more year inscribed in ink that never quite dries.

events.name: Galley Night
events.text: The new moon over Celephaïs: galleys come down out of the clouds to sail for Serannian, the sky-sea opens for fishing, and Kuranes may lay a feast.

events.name: The Onyx Fair of Inquanok
events.text: Onyx Tickets for turning up and staying; flares at the booth and the Veiled Priest's fortunes. See the Onyx Fair page.
